description: [Native ISP] Get a link to add US dollars to the account balance that pays for Native ISP orders and renewals. The person opens the link, chooses card, PayPal or crypto and pays. This balance does not buy residential GB; use residential_top_up for that. Nothing is charged by this tool.

amount_usd.description: US dollars to add, 5 to 10000. Use shortfall_usd from isp_quote_order when topping up for an order.
